entities.summary: Antonio Maria Priuli (1707–1772) was a Roman Catholic cardinal who served as Cardinal-Priest of San Marco (1762–1772), Bishop of Padova (1767–1772), Cardinal-Priest of Santa Maria della Pace (1759–1762), and Bishop of Vicenza (1738–1767).
